name: Gentle Masjid
summary: A welcoming mosque with a generous warm dome and two balanced, softly pointed towers.
why: One continuous wall connects both towers and the hall. The dome and open doorway share the same centerline, while the dome color joins the wall directly at the cornice.
risk: Its softness is intentional; it favors warmth over monumental grandeur.

palette.name: GENTLE MASJID / PLASTER + EARTH + WARM GOLD

reasonToChoose: You want an immediately recognizable mosque with a gentle presence.
